name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source Scrum and project management board with sprints, tasks and plugins, backed by PostgreSQL, Valkey and RustFS object storage.

alerts.message: Sign in with the ADMIN_USERNAME and ADMIN_PASSWORD values from the environment variables. The admin account is created on first start only; changing ADMIN_PASSWORD later does not update it, so change the password from the app instead.
The AI agent runner is not included because it needs direct access to the host's container engine, so AI agents cannot run tasks. Boards, sprints, docs and plugins work normally.
